contents.text: Compare Microsoft's and Oracle's total revenue.

Microsoft's total revenue for the year ended June 30, 2026, is $331,839 million, while Oracle's total revenue for the year ended May 31, 2026, is $67,357 million. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA; ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations).
